Epic Games Store Announces ‘Sorry We’re Closed’ as October’s Free Game (Oct 22 – Nov 5, 2026)

Epic Games Store’s October Freebie

The Epic Games Store (EGS) has officially announced that the survival‑horror title “Sorry We’re Closed” will be the sole free game offered during its October 2026 giveaway period.

Confirmed details from the announcement

  • Merchant: Epic Games Store (US‑based platform)
  • Free item: *Sorry We’re Closed* (UK studio à la mode games)
  • Claim window: 22 October 2026 – 5 November 2026 (ends at 8 a.m. PT / 11 a.m. ET / 4 p.m. CET)
  • Eligibility: Any user with an active Epic Games account can claim the game; no purchase or subscription is required.
  • Cost to the user: $0 (full game download).
  • Retail price (for reference): $24.99 (as listed on the store).
  • Delivery method: Digital download – no shipping costs apply.
  • Redemption process: Users must log into the Epic Games Store, navigate to the “Free Games” section, and click “Get” before the deadline.
  • Verification: The promotion can be confirmed on the official Epic Games Store website under the October 2026 free‑games banner.

Reported context and background

  • The title was first released in November 2024 and received an “Strong” rating on OpenCritic (average score 82, 86 % recommendation).
  • This marks the second time the game has been offered for free on EGS; the first instance was a 24‑hour giveaway that ran through 22 December 2025.
  • Unlike the previous short‑term giveaway, the October promotion will remain available for a full week, a format not used for this title before.
  • The announcement also notes that the last single‑product giveaway before this was “Alone With You” in early September 2026.
  • Other horror‑themed titles currently free on the store (as of the article’s date) include Sker Ritual and Home, both available until 29 October 2026.
  • A non‑horror game, GetHigh.EXE, is also free but its discount ends on 2 November 2026 and is unrelated to the weekly giveaway.

Practical implications for gamers

  • No hidden fees: Because the game is a digital download, there are no shipping or handling costs.
  • Account requirement: Players must have an Epic Games account; creating one is free.
  • One‑time claim: Once claimed, the game is added permanently to the user’s library, even after the promotion ends.
  • No auto‑renewal or subscription: The offer does not involve a trial period, subscription, or automatic charge.
  • How to verify: Visit the official Epic Games Store website (https://www.epicgames.com/store) and look for the October 2026 free‑games banner or the specific game page for *Sorry We’re Closed*. The page will display a “Get” button and the claim deadline.

Unknowns / unconfirmed aspects

  • The source does not specify whether Epic will add any additional surprise freebies on 31 October 2026 (Halloween).
  • No official redemption URL is provided in the source; users must locate the offer through the store’s homepage or free‑games section.
  • The article mentions a “possibility of a surprise freebie” but does not confirm any such plan.

What to watch for next

  • After 5 November 2026, the store is expected to return to a broader mix of limited‑time freebies, as indicated by the source.
  • Players interested in the horror theme may also want to claim Sker Ritual and Home before their 29 October deadline.

--- *All information is drawn from the GameRant article titled “Epic Games Store's Final Free Game for October 2026 Officially Revealed” and reflects the details publicly announced by Epic Games.*
